title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US stocks subdued at open as traders monitor Hormuz developments - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: Wall ​Street's main ​indexes opened little changed ​on Monday, as investors weighed developments in ‌the Middle ⁠East ⁠that could influence ​the reopening of the Strait ​of Hormuz and braced for a ​week laden ⁠with crucial ‌inflation ​data and ​earnings.
